notablePrerequisites:
Kalamax is tapped.
You have not cast another instant this turn.
description:
Cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Double Major targeting Dualcaster Mage by paying {U}{G}.
Kalamax triggers, copying the Double Major, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copied Double Major, resolving a copy of Dualcaster Mage.
The Dualcaster Mage copy enters, copying Double Major, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 4.
